packageRules.description: Major updates (any manager): manual review.
Minor and patch updates (any manager): automerge after release-age delay.
Pre-1.0 minor updates (cargo + npm): manual review. Belt-and-braces — Renovate's isBreaking() handles cargo, but npm classification of 0.x minor as breaking is less certain.
Pin and digest updates: automerge with no release-age delay (mechanical changes).

Never manage our own first-party image in the chart's default values. image.tag is intentionally empty so the deployment template resolves it to .Chart.AppVersion; digest-pinning it appends @sha256 to an empty tag and renders a malformed `repo:@sha256:...` reference (InvalidImageName). appVersion already tracks the release.
devDependencies and pnpm catalog devDeps: automerge minor + patch.
sqlx family: manual review. Compile-time SQL checking; minor bumps may shift macro behavior.
axum family patch: explicit automerge for axum's high-stakes changelog history (already covered by rule 2).
ts-rs: manual review. Type bridge to frontend; even minor/patch could regenerate types. CI's verify-types step catches drift.

OpenTelemetry Rust ecosystem (cross-repo): bundle every otel-coupled crate into one PR. Matched by crate NAME, not source URL: the opentelemetry-rust monorepo crates publish per-subdirectory `repository` deep-links (e.g. https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-rust/tree/main/opentelemetry-sdk) that don't equal the bare repo root, and matchSourceUrls matches exactly — so the old source-URL rule silently grouped almost nothing and the crates spilled into separate PRs (the diamond split this rule exists to prevent). Covers the opentelemetry-rust monorepo (opentelemetry, opentelemetry_sdk, opentelemetry-otlp, opentelemetry-http, opentelemetry-semantic-conventions), opentelemetry-system-metrics, tracing-opentelemetry, and axum-otel-metrics. 0.x ecosystem upgrades are coordinated breaking changes, so manual review and a single coherent PR are both required.
tokio ecosystem custom group: tokio + tokio-util together; patch automerged.
tower ecosystem custom group: tower + tower-http together.
Svelte ecosystem custom group: minor + patch automerged. No forced commitMessagePrefix — Renovate uses fix(deps): only when the group includes a runtime member (svelte), and chore(deps): otherwise.
Svelte ecosystem major: manual review.
tailwind-merge major: manual review (separate org from tailwindcssMonorepo preset).
typescript / vite / eslint major: manual review.
Playwright custom group: @playwright/test + @bgotink/playwright-coverage; minor + patch automerged.
github-actions major: manual review.
github-actions minor / patch / digest: automerge.
Dockerfile + docker-compose minor / patch / digest: automerge with pinDigests.
Dockerfile + docker-compose major: manual review.
mise minor / patch: automerge.
mise major: manual review.
Cross-manager rust-toolchain group: mise rust pin + dockerfile ARG default. Manual review (toolchain upgrades).
Cross-manager pnpm-version group: mise pnpm pin + npm packageManager field; minor/patch automerged. Renovate regenerates pnpm-lock.yaml as part of the PR.
Cross-manager pnpm-version major: manual review (pnpm v10 -> v11 may need packageManager field migration).

Security advisories: bypass schedule and release-age; automerge non-major. Both schedule and automergeSchedule are needed: the former gates branch/PR creation, the latter gates Renovate's automerge poll.
Major security advisories: manual review. Overrides the catch-all security automerge above.
